recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key fashion portrait set in a perspective-heavy hallway, featuring a woman in a white one-shoulder dress. The composition is split vertically, with the left half dominated by clean white negative space and the right half containing the subject and architectural depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's verticality aligned with the right third of the frame
Extreme perspective lines of the hallway floor converging toward the top right
Interaction between the subject's hand and the vertical white divide
Contrast between the flat white negative space and the textured, patterned floor
coreInvariants: Left-aligned typography overlapping the central divide

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure positioned in the right half, scaled to occupy approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and voluminous dark hair, balanced by the strong horizontal text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the arm to the left white space, drops to the typography, and follows the floor perspective back to the subject's feet.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white void on the left 50% of the frame, creating a clean canvas for text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and ambers (patterned carpet, skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation overall with localized warmth in the floor pattern.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to neutrals and warm earth tones

characterSpecificRedesigns: Wide 'M' and 'A' characters to emphasize horizontal span

composition.overlap: Overlaps both white space and subject's arm

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic weight contrast using a single typeface family or very similar geometric sans-serifs.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric proportions and sharp terminals.
Modern, clean, and works well with wide tracking.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key photograph of a woman with voluminous dark hair wearing a white one-shoulder dress, walking in a hallway with a brown patterned carpet. The left half of the image should be a flat white wall or negative space. Use soft, bright lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of left-aligned uppercase text in a light geometric sans-serif. The top line should be large and dark grey; the bottom line should be smaller, taupe-colored, and have very wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the left half of the image predominantly empty white space?
Does the text overlap the boundary between the white space and the hallway?
Is the perspective of the floor leading toward the upper right corner?

adjustableVariables: Exact vertical position of the text block
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the model

mustAchieve: Strong sense of depth through perspective

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the white background.
Check that the model's pose feels natural and fashion-oriented.
Verify the color palette remains restricted to white, brown, and charcoal.
Confirm the vertical split is roughly 50/50.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, off-center fashion portrait with a minimalist white void and wide-tracked geometric sans-serif typography for a modern soul or R&B aesthetic.
